description: Adds endpoint members to a group. Each added member must be the ID of an existing endpoint the caller can read; a malformed ID is BAD_REQUEST, and a missing or unreadable endpoint is NOT_FOUND.

etag.description: The group etag the client last read. When an earlier operation in the same request changes this group, send the etag that operation reports instead: every operation that changes the group advances its etag by one, and one that changes nothing keeps it.
